cohort: Women aged 15-54 years who gave birth in a hospital between January 2016 and December 2019
finding: Uterine adenomyosis was associated with an increased risk of placental pathology (placenta accreta spectrum, placenta abruption, and placenta previa) and adverse maternal outcomes at delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was increased in women with adenomyosis (aOR 7.72, 95% CI: 7.04-8.47).
